load files (ran on cloud and pulled down output files)
**need to replace this with pull from google drive**
```{r}
load("output_data/from cloud workstation/rescomb_phi.Rdata")
res_comb_phi <- res_comb
load("output_data/from cloud workstation/rescomb_cov.Rdata")
res_comb_cov <- res_comb
load("output_data/from cloud workstation/rescomb_lowtrips.Rdata")
res_comb_trips <- res_comb
load("output_data/from cloud workstation/rescomb_biomass.Rdata")
res_comb_biomass <- res_comb
```

rename columns & combine into single dataset
```{r}
metric_results <- bind_rows(
  res_comb_phi %>%
    mutate(metric = 'phi', .before=1) %>%
    rename(value = targ_phi),
  
  res_comb_cov %>%
    mutate(metric = 'cov') %>%
    rename(value = targ_cov),
  
  res_comb_trips %>%
    mutate(metric = 'trips') %>%
    rename(value = ntrips),
  
  res_comb_biomass %>%
    mutate(metric = 'biomass') %>%
    rename(value = targ_biomass)
)
```

check reps - should be 50 each
```{r}
metric_results %>%
  count(metric, value)
```

make plot
```{r}
metric_results %>%
  select(metric, value, perma_p, mvglm_p) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c(perma_p, mvglm_p), names_to = "test", values_to = "p") %>%
  group_by(metric, value, test) %>%
  summarize(psig = mean(p<=0.05), .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(value = case_when(
                         metric == "biomass" ~ log10(value), 
                         metric == "cov" ~ value*100,
                         TRUE ~ value
                       ), 
         metric = factor(metric, levels = c("biomass", "cov", "phi", "trips"),
                  labels = c("total biomass (log scale)", "coverage rate (% of trips)",
                             "phi", "total fleet trips (N)")
                        ),
         test = factor(test, levels = c("mvglm_p","perma_p"),
                       labels = c("MVGLM", "permanova")
                       )
      ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=value, y=psig, col=test, group=test)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales="free_x") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x=NULL, y="proportion of simulations with significant results",
       title = "Power vs. simulation parameters",
       subtitle = "50 replicates per value")
```
